narratives.Overview:
Dual-path graduation (issue 2899). Orientation and ritual still consume a large share of early tool calls. This Now path composes doctor and toolchain preflight into the mutation session start verb, adds deposit-sha no-ops for refresh paths, and offers opt-in compact output while preserving issue 2176 read-only routing and the dual-path Later graduation.

## Now deliverable

Compose doctor and preflight as inline sections with per-section status lines. Deposit-sha fast-path: when payload, templates, and engine fingerprints match, refresh surfaces print a one-line unchanged-sha-match no-op. Compact output is opt-in via the compact flag or DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT; verbose remains the default. No new command; no change to issue 2176 read-only-default routing.

Expected effect: fewer orientation tool calls on mutation session start; repeat sessions near free.

## Later graduation target (status open)

A future unified orientation verb with advisory and mutation postures and per-section machine status. Graduation trigger: post-3282 run-summary telemetry shows ritual plus gate share at least 25 percent of tool calls on a benchmark-suite run after Now ships. Completing Now does not close Later.

## Acceptance sketch (Now)

Session start output includes doctor and preflight sections with status lines. Second session with an unchanged deposit sha prints sha-match no-ops for refresh surfaces. Compact flag is terse; default is verbose. Issue 2176 read-only behavior identical. Run summary records orientation call count.

Refs issues 3282, 3284, 2176, 3214, 1149, 865, 2899.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Compose doctor + preflight sections in packages/core/src/session session:start and packages/cli/src/commands session handlers.
2. Add deposit-sha fast-path short-circuits in packages/core/src/agents-refresh and cache-fresh verifier modules.
3. Implement --compact / DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT formatting in session output renderer without changing #2176 read-only routing.
4. Verify with pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src -t session:start and -t compact; second session asserts sha-match no-ops.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent at session start, I want doctor and preflight composed into session:start with deposit-sha fast-paths, so that orientation costs fewer tool calls without losing read-only defaults.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a mutation session start, when orientation runs, then output includes doctor and preflight sections each with their own status line.
Given an unchanged deposit sha on a second session, when agents:refresh and verify:cache-fresh run, then each prints a one-line sha-match no-op and performs no refresh work.
Given --compact or DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT, when session:start runs, then orientation uses terse machine format while default verbose output remains unchanged.
Given a read-only session under #2176, when session:start runs after this change, then mutation ritual steps remain deferred exactly as before.
Given Now deliverables complete, when the issue is closed for Now, then Later unified orient graduation stays open with documented telemetry trigger.
